configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server. Colour codes can be used: ^0=Black, ^1=Red, ^2=Green, ^3=Yellow, ^4=Blue, ^5=Cyan, ^6=Pink, ^7=White, ^8=Team Colours, ^9=Grey, ^:=Rainbow

configurationFields.label: Message Of The Day
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom message of the day (MOTD) displayed when players join. Colour codes can also be used, as per the Server Name. Empty = default intel messages

configurationFields.label: Enable Private LAN Party Mode
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will be unlisted publicly and added to the local serverlist only. Otherwise, heartbeats will be sent to the online serverlist

configurationFields.label: Internet/LAN Server
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will be started as an internet server. Otherwise, it will be started as a LAN server

configurationFields.label: Server Admin Username
configurationFields.description: Sets the admin username for administrative purposes

configurationFields.label: Server Admin Email Address
configurationFields.description: Sets the email address for the server admin for administrative purposes

configurationFields.label: Server Admin Website
configurationFields.description: Sets the URL for the server admin's website

configurationFields.label: Server Location
configurationFields.description: Sets the server location that is displayed in the server information

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password to join the server

configurationFields.label: RCON Timeout
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum allowed interval between RCON messages per IP address

configurationFields.label: Map Rotation List
configurationFields.description: Sets the map list to use for map rotations for the server. Each entry must be in the format: map <mapname>. To mix gametypes, use the format: gametype <gametype> map <mapname>. See userraw/server.cfg for mapnames

configurationFields.label: Randomise Map Rotation
configurationFields.description: If set, the loading order of the Map Rotation List maps will be randomised

configurationFields.label: Default Gametype
configurationFields.description: Sets the default gametype in case the Map Rotation List does not specify gametypes. Settings for each gametype can be set in userraw/server.cfg

configurationFields.label: Load Mod
configurationFields.description: Sets the mod to load when starting the server, based on the path to the mod in the mods directory

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server

configurationFields.label: Maximum Ping
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum ping permitted for a player to be allowed to join. If a custom DLC reports the 'server is for low ping players only', set to 0

configurationFields.label: Client Timeout Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the time before the server will kick a client if no response is sent to the server

configurationFields.label: Player Inactivity Kick Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the time before the server will kick a player for inactivity

configurationFields.label: Spectator Kick Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the time before the server will kick a spectator

configurationFields.label: Temporary Ban Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the time for a player temporary ban (on kick/tempban)

configurationFields.label: Security Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the server's security level

configurationFields.label: Enable Pure Server
configurationFields.description: If enabled, only clients with verified files will be able to join the server

configurationFields.label: XP Scaling Factor
configurationFields.description: Sets the XP scaling factor. DO NOT ABUSE! Warn of high XP via hostname. Don't change this unless you know what you are doing

configurationFields.label: Enable Voice Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, server voice chat will be enabled (teams only)

configurationFields.label: Voice Chat Quality
configurationFields.description: Sets the server voice quality level

configurationFields.label: Disable Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, chat messages from clients will be disabled

configurationFields.label: Allow Download From Web
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be allowed to download maps and mods from a different server instead of the game server

configurationFields.label: Web Download URL
configurationFields.description: Sets the http URL to a usermaps and mods folder on a web server for clients to download from. Note that https does NOT work!

configurationFields.label: Enable Flood Protection
configurationFields.description: If enabled, chat spam protection applies. Should be enabled on non-password-protected public servers

configurationFields.label: Reconnect Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of times a player can reconnect after disconnection

configurationFields.label: Allow Voting
configurationFields.description: If enabled, voting will be allowed on the server

configurationFields.label: Allow Client Console
configurationFields.description: If enabled, players will be able to access server commands

configurationFields.label: Server-Side Say Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name that server-side 'say' commands show up as in-game

configurationFields.label: Randomise Bot Names
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the names of bots will be randomised

configurationFields.label: Replace Bots
configurationFields.description: If enabled, test clients will be replaced by connecting players when the server is full

configurationFields.label: Allow Aim Assist
configurationFields.description: If set, Controller Aim-Assist will be enabled

configurationFields.label: Allow Coloured Names
configurationFields.description: If enabled, colours in player names will be allowed

authenticationRequirements.label: Steam-Konto
authenticationRequirements.description: Ein Steam-Konto mit Berechtigung für dieses Spiel hinterlegen. Steam Guard kann einmalig erforderlich sein.
